claim_not_supported: Finite C2 black-box samples can certify that a returned singular root is locally isolated.

audit.result: A general C-infinity bump construction preserves every value, Jacobian, directional-Hessian, semantic and target observation in any finite adaptive transcript while changing local isolation.

counterexample_structure: After any finite query transcript, choose a punctured neighborhood of the candidate containing no queried point other than the candidate. A locally finite sum of compactly supported C-infinity bumps, flat through every observed C2 jet, can create roots accumulating at the candidate while leaving the complete finite transcript identical to an isolated-root oracle. The two indistinguishable oracles require opposite isolation decisions, so no finite sampled C2 gate can safely promote isolation.
current_decision: Remove the rejected implementation, tests, dependency and runtime knobs. Preserve only this bounded negative decision. The mechanism may generate research proposals but has no numerical-confirmation, exact-answer or promotion authority.
proposal_only_reopen_gate: Promotion requires independent neighborhood-wide isolation authority: a validated derivative-remainder bound with interval exclusion, or a C3A exact local-dimension/root-isolation proof. Finite point samples, higher precision replay, PSLQ, tensor spectra and repeated local convergence are insufficient.
